d:
Arunachal Pradesh is my favourite state in India, and this time I came back to learn how to fly.
I joined NIMAS for paragliding training in Pappu Valley, at Lumdung near Seppa. My first challenge was on the ground: could I bring the wing up, keep it overhead and keep running at the same time? The instructor made it look easy. Then I got my hands on the lines.
This is the first of two videos from my course. Come along as I get familiar with the harness, practise ground handling and complete my P1 training. In the next episode, my feet finally leave the ground for my first flight!
